mapper.select: SELECT model_id as modelId, model_name as modelName, model_type as modelType, model_version as modelVersion, is_loaded as isLoaded, model_path as modelPath, accuracy, last_trained_time as lastTrainedTime, training_data_size as trainingDataSize, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM ml_model_info ORDER BY model_id

SELECT model_id as modelId, model_name as modelName, model_type as modelType, model_version as modelVersion, is_loaded as isLoaded, model_path as modelPath, accuracy, last_trained_time as lastTrainedTime, training_data_size as trainingDataSize FROM ml_model_info WHERE model_type = #{modelType}
mapper.update: UPDATE ml_model_info SET is_loaded = #{isLoaded}, update_time = NOW() WHERE model_type = #{modelType}
UPDATE ml_model_info SET accuracy = #{accuracy}, last_trained_time = #{lastTrainedTime}, training_data_size = #{trainingDataSize}, update_time = NOW() WHERE model_type = #{modelType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ml_training_history ( model_type, training_status, progress, current_step, start_time, training_days, data_size, create_time ) VALUES ( #{modelType}, #{trainingStatus}, #{progress}, #{currentStep}, #{startTime}, #{trainingDays}, #{dataSize}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ml_training_history SET progress = #{progress}, current_step = #{currentStep}, training_status = #{status}, elapsed_time = TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_time, NOW()) WHERE training_id = #{trainingId}

UPDATE ml_training_history SET training_status = #{status}, end_time = NOW(), elapsed_time = TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_time, NOW()), accuracy = #{accuracy}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, progress = 100, current_step = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'completed' THEN '训练完成' ELSE current_step END WHERE training_id = #{trainingId}
mapper.select: SELECT training_id as trainingId, model_type as name, model_type as modelType, training_status as status, training_status as trainingStatus, progress, current_step as currentStep, start_time as startTime, training_days as trainingDays, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, start_time, NOW()) as elapsedTime FROM ml_training_history WHERE training_status IN ('pending', 'training', 'completed', 'failed') AND start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) ORDER BY start_time DESC

SELECT training_id as trainingId, model_type as modelType, training_status as trainingStatus, progress, current_step as currentStep, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, elapsed_time as elapsedTime, accuracy, error_message as errorMessage FROM ml_training_history WHERE model_type = #{modelType} ORDER BY training_id DESC LIMIT 1

-- 从diet_recommendation表按算法类型统计真实数据 SELECT COALESCE(algorithm_type, 'rule_based') as algorithmType, -- 准确率 = 接受率（基于真实反馈） ROUND( COALESCE( COUNT(CASE WHEN is_accepted = '1' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN is_accepted IS NOT NULL AND is_accepted != '' THEN 1 END), 0), 0 ), 4 ) as acceptanceRate, -- 响应时间（ms） CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(response_time), 75), 0) AS SIGNED) as avgResponseTime, -- 推荐次数 CAST(COUNT(*) AS SIGNED) as totalRecommendations, -- 平均评分 ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(score), 0), 2) as avgScore, -- 使用占比 ROUND( COUNT(*) * 100.0 / ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diet_recommendation WHERE recommendation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ), 2 ) as `usage`, -- 状态（固定为运行中） 'running' as status FROM diet_recommendation WHERE recommendation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY COALESCE(algorithm_type, 'rule_based') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ml_recommendation_stats ( stat_date, algorithm_type, total_recommendations, accepted_recommendations, acceptance_rate, avg_score, avg_response_time, active_users, create_time ) VALUES ( #{statDate}, #{algorithmType}, #{stats.totalRecommendations}, #{stats.acceptedRecommendations}, #{stats.acceptanceRate}, #{stats.avgScore}, #{stats.avgResponseTime}, #{stats.activeUsers}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_recommendations = VALUES(total_recommendations), accepted_recommendations = VALUES(accepted_recommendations), acceptance_rate = VALUES(acceptance_rate), avg_score = VALUES(avg_score), avg_response_time = VALUES(avg_response_time), active_users = VALUES(active_users), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(recommendation_date) as statDate, COALESCE(algorithm_type, 'rule_based') as algorithmType, COUNT(*) as totalRecommendations, SUM(CASE WHEN is_accepted = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as acceptedRecommendations, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN is_accepted = '1' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) as acceptanceRate, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) as avgScore, ROUND(AVG(response_time), 0) as avgResponseTime, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as activeUsers FROM diet_recommendation WHERE DATE(recommendation_date) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(recommendation_date), COALESCE(algorithm_type, 'rule_based')

SELECT status_id as statusId, service_status as serviceStatus, data_loader_status as dataLoaderStatus, user_profiling_status as userProfilingStatus, recommender_status as recommenderStatus, check_time as checkTime, check_time as lastCheckTime, response_time as responseTime, error_message as errorMessage FROM ml_service_status ORDER BY check_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ml_service_status ( service_status, data_loader_status, user_profiling_status, recommender_status, check_time, response_time, error_message ) VALUES ( #{serviceStatus}, #{dataLoaderStatus}, #{userProfilingStatus}, #{recommenderStatus}, #{checkTime}, #{responseTime}, #{errorMessage} )
mapper.select:
SELECT status_id as statusId, service_status as serviceStatus, data_loader_status as dataLoaderStatus, user_profiling_status as userProfilingStatus, recommender_status as recommenderStatus, check_time as checkTime, response_time as responseTime FROM ml_service_status ORDER BY check_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
